Both transcription and approximate sample require fresh confirmation; complete scale anchors restore only after both, and pending work reopens exactly in browser and Node.
Fresh source review restores the exact gradient stops, extension paint and composition SVG; recovered output reopens byte-identically.
Opening another project discards the pending editor and prevents its prepared crop from publishing.
Opening another project while a real PDF render is held cancels preparation; releasing the old paint cannot publish its crop or alter the new project.

A real scanned PDF has zero extracted text/color observations and an explicit coverage gap; adding user evidence is a separate action.
Invalid values and values lacking retained source evidence cannot be confirmed. A user-confirmed transcription retains its crop and literal without rewriting the native capture.
Preparing a sample does not accept it. Escape declines the sample, restores keyboard focus, and leaves the saved project byte-for-byte unchanged.

Explicit sample acceptance records the exact retained center pixel as an opaque, approximate rendered sRGB value. Bounds validation, 44px controls and keyboard acceptance work at 390px without overflow.
Both accepted methods feed the shared review and gradient compiler; the review and CSS export preserve their distinct provenance notices.
V4 project, selected gradient and provenance exports reopen byte-for-byte offline without the PDF. Recorded crops remain inspectable; preparing new regions is unavailable.

Canceling a correction preserves all work. Confirming a wrong-digit correction works from the saved crop offline, appends a replacement, revokes/excludes its predecessor, and clears reviewed/generated results.
Revocation clears a selected design and excludes the sample from the next compiled review while keeping its evidence and acceptance history.
Moving to an unselected page discards the pending form and disables adding source evidence. Returning to a selected page re-enables preparation without committing the discarded value.
Corrected and revoked history survives a later project reopen with exact source and acceptance state.
Recapturing the same PDF/pages is a no-op even with a fresh capture timestamp; no revision or design reset occurs.
An unrelated selected-page edit retains both color decisions; rejecting preserves byte-exact project and gradient.
Editing the current review discards its staged proposal, preventing acceptance against a stale draft.
A real IndexedDB save failure prevents source replacement and preserves the exact selected design.
Acceptance preserves the exact prior design first, resets changed-color inclusion and applied results, and subsequent save appends the new source alongside the old revision.
A changed PDF anchor makes its previous gradient stale; restoration cannot silently substitute a new paint.
An added restriction enters the proposed draft unresolved; rejecting retains the preceding approved local review and gradient.
Malformed updated input preserves the current source, review and output.
Cancelling a delayed real File read prevents its late completion from publishing a comparison or changing the project.
Opening another project while acceptance waits on storage cancels the stale save and prevents late source replacement.
An unrelated PDF change preserves exact gradient paint under the renewed review, survives portable reopen, and a later review edit invalidates restoration.
390px comparison fits, no browser errors and no source or service network requests.
